Requirements You're in Bladework Stance.

You coalesce all your blades into your Favored Blade for a killing blow. Make a melee Strike with your Favored Blade. Its damage die increases by one step, and for every blade flying above you, you deal an additional die of damage. This Strike counts as three attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty. After using this activity, you exit your Bladework Stance.

Foundry: using this turns on True Blade's Strike for your next Strike with the Favored Blade (die one step larger, plus a die per flying blade); after its damage roll you leave Bladework Stance.
